description: This file defines a singleton class 'RefreshBroadcast' that provides an event-based mechanism to broadcast refresh requests within a Blazor application.

classes.name: RefreshBroadcast
classes.description: A singleton class that manages an event to notify subscribers when a refresh is requested.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Invokes the RefreshRequested event to signal that a refresh should occur.
